description: Links a dietary supplement product reported by NHANES participants to a compound ingredient it contains, with the reported ingredient amounts.

common_properties.name: last_updated
common_properties.description: Time the relationship was last created or updated.

common_properties.name: quantity
common_properties.description: Reported amount for each contributing ingredient.

common_properties.name: unit
common_properties.description: Raw NHANES amount-unit code for each contributing ingredient; the source documentation provides no label table.

common_properties.name: operator
common_properties.description: Amount comparison operator (=, <, or >) for each contributing ingredient.

common_properties.name: category
common_properties.description: Ingredient category: Vitamin, Mineral, Botanical, Other, or Amino acid. When contributing ingredients have different categories, the value is Other.

source_contributions.scope: Dietary supplement products and discrete compound ingredients in the NHANES Dietary Supplement Database. Only ingredients mapped to an existing Compound are represented; unresolved ingredients are absent.
source_contributions.description: The CDC / National Center for Health Statistics publishes the Product Information (DSPI) and Ingredient Information (DSII) data. Compound assignments use a curated, human-reviewed mapping of ingredient names. Mineral salts and chelates map to the mineral rather than the ligand; class, family, and plural ingredient labels map to the class node. A relationship can represent different named ingredients in the same product that map to the same compound. The quantity, unit, and operator lists are index-aligned: element i refers to the same contributing ingredient in each list. Each list has length 1 when a single ingredient contributes.
